h1: Radiofrequency Microneedling with Morpheus8 in Huntington Beach
intro: Radiofrequency (RF) microneedling with Morpheus8 is a skin treatment that combines fine needles with radiofrequency energy delivered through the needle tips to remodel collagen and tighten skin from within. It is a good fit for adults who want to improve texture, acne scars, fine lines, enlarged pores or mild skin laxity on the face or body.

quickFacts.label: Downtime
quickFacts.value: Often a few days of redness, swelling and tiny grid marks

whatIs: Morpheus8® is a radiofrequency microneedling device made by InMode. Like standard microneedling, it creates tiny controlled channels in the skin. The difference is that the needles also deliver radiofrequency energy beneath the surface, gently heating the deeper layers. Your skin responds to this combination by producing new collagen and elastin and remodeling existing tissue, which can lead to smoother texture, softer scars and a firmer, tighter look over time.

Because needle depth and energy can be adjusted, the treatment can be tailored to delicate areas around the face as well as larger body areas such as the neck, abdomen or arms. It is often chosen when someone wants more than surface refinement, such as deeper acne scarring or early laxity. All services are performed under Tran Plastic Surgery, led by Dr. Tuan Tran, a triple board-certified plastic, reconstructive and hand surgeon.
goodFor: Mild skin laxity on the face, jawline or neck

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We review your goals, skin history, medications and any implants or devices, examine your skin and confirm whether Morpheus8 or standard microneedling is the better fit.

steps.title: Prep and numbing
steps.text: Your skin is cleansed and a topical numbing cream is applied and left on for a period of time so treatment is as comfortable as possible.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: The provider moves the handpiece across each area in a careful pattern, adjusting needle depth and energy settings for different parts of the face or body.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.text: Soothing products are applied, and you go home with clear instructions on cleansing, sun protection and when to resume your usual skincare.

expect.before: Avoid retinoids, exfoliating acids and sunburn for several days beforehand. Tell us if you are pregnant, have an active skin infection or cold sores, have a pacemaker or other implanted device or metal implants, have taken isotretinoin recently, or tend to form keloid scars. Your provider decides whether treatment is appropriate for you.
expect.during: With numbing cream, most people feel pressure, warmth and a prickling sensation as the energy is delivered. Bonier areas such as the forehead and jawline may feel more noticeable.
expect.after: Expect redness and swelling for a few days, along with tiny grid marks that typically fade as the skin heals. Keep skin clean, follow your aftercare instructions, avoid heavy workouts and heat at first, and wear sunscreen daily. Results continue to develop over about 3 months.

faqs.a: Price depends on your plan, including the areas treated and the number of sessions recommended. You receive an exact quote at your free consultation.

faqs.q: How much downtime is there after Morpheus8?
faqs.a: Most people have redness and swelling for a few days, and small grid marks from the needles may be visible while skin heals. Many return to work quickly with light coverage once the skin has settled. Downtime varies with the depth and energy used.

faqs.q: How long do Morpheus8 results last?
faqs.a: Results come from your own new collagen, so they build gradually over about 3 months and can last a long time. Skin keeps aging, so many people choose a maintenance session periodically. Results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed.

Numbing cream is applied before treatment to keep you comfortable. Most people feel heat, pressure and prickling, which is usually described as tolerable, and settings can be adjusted during the session.

faqs.q: Who is a good candidate for RF microneedling?
faqs.a: Healthy adults concerned about texture, acne scars, fine lines, pores or mild laxity are often good candidates. It may not be suitable during pregnancy, with an active infection, with certain implants or electronic devices, after recent isotretinoin use or with a tendency to form keloids. Your provider reviews this at your consultation.

faqs.q: How is Morpheus8 different from standard microneedling?
faqs.a: Standard microneedling uses needles alone to trigger collagen near the surface and usually has 1–3 days of redness. Morpheus8 adds radiofrequency energy through the needles to heat deeper layers, which can offer more remodeling and tightening with a little more downtime. Our Huntington Beach team helps you choose at your free consultation.
